Color palette definitions for CSIDS styling

Source: R/1_environments.r
colors.Rd

A list containing named colors, base colors, and predefined color palettes for consistent visualization styling.

Usage

colors

Format

An object of class list of length 4.

Value

List with color definitions including named_colors, base color, and palettes

See also

Other csstyle_utilities: display_all_palettes(), every_nth(), set_global()

Examples

# Access named colors
colors$named_colors["H1"]
#>        H1 
#> "#393C61" 

# View primary palette
colors$palettes$primary_3
#>        H1        H4        H2 
#> "#393C61" "#709900" "#0975B5" 

# See all available palettes
names(colors$palettes)
#>  [1] "primary_1"  "primary_2"  "primary_3"  "primary_4"  "primary_5" 
#>  [6] "primary_6"  "primary_7"  "primary_8"  "primary_9"  "primary_10"
#> [11] "primary_11" "primary_12" "warning_3"  "posneg_2"
